Mesa and glslang notices
=======================

Mesa-license.rst is the upstream Mesa 25.2.8 licensing overview.
mesa/ is the complete upstream set of standard license texts. Its presence
does not mean every Mesa component is enabled in this build.
Mesa-build-NOTICES.txt collects distinct copyright/license comment blocks from
the compiler inputs and dependency headers of the embedded lavapipe build.
radix-sort-LICENSE.txt preserves the separately licensed Vulkan radix-sort code.
glslang-LICENSE.txt is the complete glslang 15.4.0 source license; glslang is a
host build tool and is not linked into the resulting software driver.

The complete original sources, including individual file notices, are retained
in the release archives pinned by ../PIN.json. Port patches retain those notices.
LLVM and Cosmopolitan notices are supplied by their own build/import recipes.
